name: Viet Nam
headline: Viet Nam: +8.0% growth in 2025, 3.3% inflation, debt 31% of GDP
sections: Viet Nam is a $494 billion economy (2025), the world's 33rd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +8.0% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $18K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 24.5% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 3.3% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges. Unemployment stood at 2.2% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 6.2% (2025).
Gross government debt is 31% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 41% in 2020. The general government balance is +0.0% of GDP (2025), a surplus.
The current account balance is +6.7% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 190% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 4.3% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 25% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 74.7 years (2024). Population: 102.3 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
